title: Adding writes an internal work order note and an audit entry
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A due service is visible on a work order, the worklist or the asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Add a service to a work order.
  2. Read the work order note that is written.
  3. Confirm the note is internal (never shown to the customer).
  4. Open the audit and find the entry.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Adding writes one short internal work order note naming the service and the schedule it came from (for example 'PM-A added from Highway Tractor PM'); it never mentions copying.
  • The note is never visible to the customer, so it sends no customer email.
  • Adding writes an audit entry with actor and timestamp.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10573 (S17, Add a service to a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S17; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S17-R5: “Adding writes one short internal work order note naming the service and the schedule it came from, for example PM-A added from Highway Tractor PM. It never mentions copying; each copied line's own note does, per S16-R23. The note is never visible to the customer, so it sends no customer email”
  • S17-R6: “Adding will write an audit entry with actor and timestamp”
